services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Camp-inspired activities and Bible lessons provide a week of both fun and faith for children completing grades 2-5. Highlights include crafts, swimming, singing, hiking, games, and campfires. Sleeping in a tent, cooking over an open fire, exploring endless trails, stomping through the creek while learning about God’s creation - these are some of the highlights of a week at Indian Point with Adventure Camp. With cutting edge games and spirit-filled worship, high schoolers have the opportunity to combine faith and friendship in a way that challenges the mind and stirs the heart. services.name: Moore Cabin
services.desc: Fully renovated in 2004, Sunshine Cabin shares a very similar footprint to MacArthur cabin. A common entryway leads to two bunk rooms, one on the left and one on the right. Each room sleeps 8. Two separate but full bathrooms are accessible from the center hallway. The room on the left also has a separate entry. Sunshine is the cabin closest to the Conference Center and can be used by Conference Center groups as overflow or alternative lodging for guests. Like all of our cabins, Sunshine is designed as a simple, but comfortable lodging facility for your Redwood Glen stay.
